messages:
nina: Heads-up — our rewrap batch hitting AWS KMS limits again for tenant t-845.
nina: rewrap job started at 03:10 UTC, a bunch of 429s in the logs. seeing envelope rewrap failures ~ 12/s.
sec-bot: [alert] kms-throttle: key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd1234 — 429 spikes detected
samir: Can you paste the extract of the error log? is it 429 or 400/403?
nina: it's 429 ThrottlingException. excerpt:
```
2026-03-19T03:12:10Z rewrap-service t-845 msg="rekey:encrypt" err="ThrottlingException: Rate exceeded" key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd1234
```
oliver: Are we hitting a single CMK or multiple? If single CMK, we need to shard the requests or use a KMS-backed envelope key cache.
maddie: We deliberately pinned tenant t-845 to a customer CMK after contract. That one key is the hot spot.
amanda: RBAC note — any change to rewrap tooling needs approval from compliance. but for throttling mitigation we can do config-only changes.
samir: Options:
- introduce per-job token bucket to limit calls/sec per CMK
- implement exponential backoff + jitter (we have that but seems insufficient)
- use intermediate DEK rotate: fetch one DEK per shard and rotate locally vs calling KMS per-object
- request increase from AWS (slow, not immediate)
- fallback to GCP KMS or Azure? (not possible for this customer CMK)

nina: We already do backoff but not per-key coordination. If multiple workers coordinate they still all retry and cause stampede.
oliver: Suggest leader election for CMK holder: single coordinator issues DEKs every X minutes and workers use cached DEKs.
maddie: That needs to be safe for rollbacks. We need idempotent checkpoints and per-tenant progress markers.
amanda: Audit log requirements: every rewrap must append an immutable audit row with old_key_id, new_key_id, object_id, operator. That means the coordinator must emit events.
sec-bot: [note] audit retention policy: 7 years for keys rotated under enterprise contracts.
oncall-ops: For immediate mitigation, throttle our workers to 5 req/s per CMK and extend job window. Patchable via config map.
samir: Quick patch command for k8s job config (ops-run):
```
kubectl set env deployment/rewrap-worker REWRAP_RATE_LIMIT=5
kubectl set env deployment/rewrap-worker REWRAP_BACKOFF_BASE_MS=500
```
nina: Applying on staging now. Will run a small test against a small set of objects.
oliver: Long term: design pattern: "CMK-leader + DEK-shard cache". Rough algorithm:
1) elect leader per-cmk
2) leader rotates a pool of ephemeral DEKs by calling KMS with GenerateDataKey for N shards
3) workers pull DEK from cache and re-encrypt locally
4) leader records audit rows and pushes checkpoint offsets
5) if leader fails, new leader reconciles by reading last audit offset

maddie: Also need to consider cross-cloud KMS. For customers using GCP KMS we should abstract same pattern. GCP quotas are separate but same hotspot problem exists.
amanda: Security review checklist: ensure DEKs never persist unencrypted on disk, audit events include provenance, and RBAC scope for the leader service account limited to GenerateDataKey / Encrypt only.
samir: Edge cases: partial rewrap (some items fail). Plan: mark object as "rewrap_in_progress" with current offset and retry later. Use idempotent migration IDs.
nina: Test results from staging: with REWRAP_RATE_LIMIT=5 we drop 429s to near zero but total job time doubled. logs:
```
2026-03-19T04:02:03Z rewrap-service info="dequeued 200 objects" cmk=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd1234
2026-03-19T04:02:04Z rewrap-service info="used cached DEK" shard=2
2026-03-19T04:03:12Z rewrap-service warn="retrying 1 objects due to transient err"
```
oliver: That's acceptable — prefer longer window over outages.
amanda: Please add the required approval ticket for RBAC/infra changes. I'll attach compliance checklist.
sec-bot: [action] create-ticket:SEC-REWRAP-2026-03-19 by nina
nina: Filed SEC-REWRAP-2026-03-19 with summary: "adaptive per-CMK rewrap throttling + leader-coordinator plan". Linking here.
oncall-ops: For production rollout, schedule gradual ramp: start 10% objects/day, monitor KMS throttles and audit writes. fallback to paused state on >5% error rate in 1hr window.
maddie: Also add monitoring: metric kms_throttle_count per cmk, rewrap_audit_write_errors, rewrap_progress_percent.
samir: I'll draft a short playbook for on-call:
- symptom: spike in kms_throttle_count
- quick mitigation: set REWRAP_RATE_LIMIT=5 for offending CMK
- check audit lag metric
- escalate to security if audit writes fail
- for contract customers: open AWS support ticket if persistent

nina: OK pushing a PR with per-CMK token bucket + leader election prototype. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rewrap/pull/621
oliver: Ping me for design review. I'll comment on DEK lifecycle and leader failover.
maddie: I'll prepare the compliance sign-off doc; want to include how we preserve audit immutability.
amanda: Once PR is ready, add me as reviewer so we can attach RBAC changes to the ticket.
sec-bot: [info] scheduled run: rewrap throttling watchlist created for cmk abcd1234
nina: Thanks all — will post updates as we roll.
